author: dev_revs
body:
Staff member reporting: _DISTRACTION_
My in-game name: dev_revs
Reason? Disrespect/negative attitude towards players. Suicide encouragement/telling a player to fall off a bridge.

http://imgur.com/a/3hvH8

In these here photos, you can see distraction talking to player "Autotool" In-game. His attitude is less than desirable for being a staff member, and is quite appalling. As a staff member, suicide should not be something you can joke. 

ALM encouraged us to report this instead of letting it slide.
